title: Add a static route to a specific network
summary: Manually add a route for a specific destination network or IP address through a gateway. This is useful for accessing private networks or specific subnets that are not automatically discovered.

steps.explain: Add a static route for a specific destination IP or network, directing traffic through a gateway and out a specific interface.
steps.cmd: sudo ip route add <DESTINATION_IP> via <GATEWAY_IP> dev <INTERFACE>

placeholders.name: DESTINATION_IP
placeholders.description: The destination IP address or network (e.g., 10.0.0.0/24)

placeholders.name: GATEWAY_IP
placeholders.description: The IP address of the gateway to use

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The network interface to use (e.g., eth0, wlan0)

rollback.explain: Delete the static route to remove it from the routing table.

placeholders.name: DESTINATION_IP
placeholders.description: The destination IP address or network

warnings: Incorrect routes can cause connectivity issues for specific networks.
Routes added this way are temporary and lost on reboot unless saved in configuration files.
